blurb: The Salt Cave Minnesota offers sessions in a hand-built Himalayan salt cave that recreates a microclimate similar to natural salt mines. Guests sit comfortably while dry salt is gently released into the room, promoting relaxation and respiratory support. Additional offerings include sound baths, meditations, yoga, deep stretch classes, reiki, and craniosacral therapy.
